## Appearance

Jane Andrews is described as neat, sensible, and plain in her overall appearance.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Jane Andrews is a plain, placid, and amiable individual known for her unshakeable, steady nature. Highly conscientious and plodding in her efforts, she approaches life pragmatically, aiming in her teaching career to earn her salary fairly, satisfy school trustees, and gain professional recognition. She harbors a desire for wealth and luxury items, such as diamonds, and has expressed a determination to devote her entire life to teaching rather than marrying.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 IV Different Opinions P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## History

Jane Andrews grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a classmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During her schooldays, she joined the local "[Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club)" organized by [Anne](../character/anne.md) to cultivate their imaginations and write romantic tales. As a young woman pursuing education, she eventually went into teaching. In addition to her own pursuits, she acted as an intermediary for her family, once making a formal marriage proposal on behalf of her shy brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) to [Anne](../character/anne.md), which [Anne](../character/anne.md) declined. Jane later married a wealthy man, becoming the wife of a millionaire, though her marriage remained a happy one. She eventually returned to visit [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) along with her mother and Mrs. Jasper Bell to inspect Anne's wedding trousseau prior to Anne's marriage.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P8](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P9](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0009), +477 more_
